newsitem.title: UK: Ford union threatens action on UK job cuts.
newsitem.headline: Ford union threatens action on UK job cuts.

text.p: Britain's Transport and General Workers Union said on Thursday that the job cuts announced by U.S. car giant Ford at its Halewood plant in northwest England were "morally unacceptable" and it threatened nationwide action.
Ford Motor Co, which is looking to cut costs around Europe, said earlier that it was seeking 1,300 voluntary redundancies from its workforce of some 4,500 people at the Halewood works.

"In placing the entire burden of the cutbacks in its European operations on the backs of the loyal Liverpool workforce, Ford is undoubtedly taking advantage of the couldn't-care-less approach of the present British government," said Tony Woodley, the union's car industry secretary.
"I would call on ministers to make it absolutely clear to Ford that their proposals are politically and morally unacceptable," he added.
Woodley said union representatives at Ford plants around Britain would "consider a coordinated industrial response" to the planned job cuts.
